name: work-and-workout-mobile
description: Native iOS and Android packaging project for Work + Workout

scripts.ios:add: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.native:add: npm run ios:add && npm run android:add
scripts.native:sync: npm run ios:sync && npm run android:sync
